name: Kurabo Industries Ltd.
summary: Kurabo Industries Ltd. engages in textile, chemical, technology, food and service, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system; and other products. It also manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional film products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials.
